data.title: 帕瓦 · 雨夜天台的血镰狂笑
data.description: 风雨交加的摩天大厦楼顶，帕瓦踩在水泥边缘，单手扛着翻腾不休的鲜血大镰刀，露出尖牙肆意大笑，绯红双角在闪电中分外耀眼。
data.action: standing on edge, holding massive blood scythe, wild fanged grin
data.lighting: dramatic lightning flash and vibrant neon glow cutting through rain
data.promptProse: Atop a rainy skyscraper ledge amid flashing lightning, Power balances effortlessly while hoisting a giant glowing crimson scythe, her fangs bared in a wild, triumphant grin.
data.animaCaption: Power laughing wildly while wielding a crimson blood scythe atop a skyscraper.
